summary: This image presents two line charts titled 'Utility Progression Over Iteration Steps' comparing LLM-based and Template-based approaches. The left chart illustrates the utility progression for various iterations, with data points showing values ranging from approximately 0 to 27 across 50 iteration steps. The right chart similarly depicts utility progression for the Template-based method, with values also reaching around 27. Both charts feature multiple colored lines representing different data series, with the x-axis labeled 'Iteration Steps' and the y-axis labeled 'Utility'. The overall trend in both charts indicates an increase in utility over the iteration steps, with some lines plateauing at higher values. The charts provide a visual comparison of the two methodologies in terms of their utility progression over time.
